display_name: The whole Metrication Act 1970 (ss 1-7) and all four Schedules, as one top-level goal (the metrication position of a measurement) over four goals: SI status, legal force, conversion, orders and the saving
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 07 Oct 2026 (text identical to 05 Oct 2026) (2020 Revised Edition): ss 1-7 and the First to Fourth Schedules, every row. Inert: the long title, s 1 and s 6 (the power to vary the Schedules). s 3(1)'s own date (15 February 1971) is encoded as the Act's answer; nothing else is gated. The Schedules are as printed; a later variation under s 6 would be a new version. Inputs: whether another written law's context excludes the Fourth Schedule (s 2(1)(b)); whether a s 4 replacement is equivalent or a desirable approximation; the date of the s 4 order touching an act (s 7(1)). Structured as a top-level goal, `the metrication position for` a Measurement (ma-goal.l4), over Goal 1 SI status (ss 2, 3(2)), Goal 2 legal force (ss 3(1), 7(2)), Goal 3 conversion (s 5, Third Schedule) and Goal 4 orders and the saving (ss 4, 7(1)).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-05 (tests-independent.l4, expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); its findings and their triage are in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The goal-level functions added on 2026-10-07 compose rules the independent pass covers; they were tested by the encoder only (ma-tests-goals.l4). The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 7(1) 'before the making of any order under section 4': before the order that touches the act in question.
